fusions.name: Reed Nibble
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 5 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Underfoot Finish
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Deals 18 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cover of Reeds
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dusk Scurry
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
